purpose: Teach: 放浪/分断/改憲/直撃/哀れ/中高年/棄却/斬り

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、海外を放浪する若者の心理を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, you were writing a paper on the psychology of young people wandering overseas, weren't you?
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle confirmation rather than interrogation. Slightly leaning in, interested. The tone of someone who's actually been reading her students' work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、社会の分断の構造を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I was exploring the structural dynamics of social fragmentation.
lines.style: Polite, focused. A beat of hesitation before the answer—he's double-checking his own memory. Quiet earnestness, not defensive. Eyes slightly down, then back up.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、改憲論議の歴史を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, you were looking into the history of constitutional amendment debates, weren't you?
lines.style: Soft, thoughtful follow-up. Slight tilt of the head, like she's piecing something together. Not accusing—curious. The pause of someone genuinely reflecting on what she's hearing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、台風が直撃する地域の防災を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I was examining disaster prevention in areas directly impacted by typhoons.
lines.style: Quiet correction with no edge. A small exhale before speaking. He's not wrong-footing her on purpose—just answering what she asked. Steady, matter-of-fact delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 哀れな主人公の物語を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, you were writing about a protagonist in a tragic story, weren't you?
lines.style: Engaged but cautious. Leaning forward slightly, genuinely interested in what he'll say. A touch of warmth underneath—she knows these don't match. Not playing gotcha, but noticing something.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、中高年の労働問題を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I was analyzing labor issues affecting middle-aged and older workers.
lines.style: Gentle persistence. Not frustrated or embarrassed. He's just answering the question honestly, the way he always does. A small, almost apologetic tone—he knows something's off but he's being truthful anyway.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、訴訟の棄却理由を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, you were researching the legal grounds for case dismissals, weren't you?
lines.style: Reflective, slower pace. Eyes narrowing slightly—not unkind, just noticing. The tone of someone who's figured out what's happening but is giving him space to figure it out too.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、武士の斬り合い文化を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I was examining the culture and practice of sword dueling among samurai.
lines.style: Quiet, a little raw at the end. He knows now. No defensiveness, no performance. Just the truth. Voice trails off slightly, leaving space for the moment to land.
